Name: Carryable Chests
Author: cylixlee
Description:
[size=6]Carryable Chests[/size]
[img]https://img.shields.io/badge/Android_Compatible-3DDC84?logo=android&logoColor=000000[/img] [img]https://img.shields.io/badge/Stardew_Valley_PC-1.6.15-138FBF[/img] [img]https://img.shields.io/badge/Stardew_Valley_Android-1.6.15-138FBF[/img] [img]https://img.shields.io/badge/SMAPI_PC-4.5.2-ff781e[/img] [img]https://img.shields.io/badge/SMAPI_Android-4.3.2.5-ff781e[/img]

Stardew Valley mod for picking up and moving chests without emptying them first.

[img]https://media.githubusercontent.com/media/cylixlee/StardewValleyMods/refs/heads/main/CarryableChests/img/cover.png[/img]

[size=5][b]How To Use[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Right-click a placed chest to open it as usual.[/*]
[*]Left-click a chest with empty hands to pick it up.[/*]
[*]Right-click while holding a chest to open it.[/*]
[*]Place the chest like any other item.[/*]
[/list][size=5][b]Settings[/b][/size]

This mod provides the following settings in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM (Generic Mod Config Menu)[/url].

[img]https://media.githubusercontent.com/media/cylixlee/StardewValleyMods/refs/heads/main/CarryableChests/img/settings.png[/img]

[size=4][b]Maximum Reach[/b][/size]

How far away a chest can be picked up from. Defaults to `1`.

[size=4][b]Require Empty Hands[/b][/size]

Whether your hands must be empty before picking up a chest. Defaults to enabled.

[size=4][b]Open Held Chest[/b][/size]

Whether right-click opens the chest you're carrying. Defaults to enabled.

[size=4][b]Heavy Chest Slowdown[/b][/size]

Whether fuller carried chests slow you down.

[b]Enabled[/b]

Whether heavy chest slowdown is enabled. Defaults to false.

[b]Starts At[/b]

Chest fill percentage before slowdown starts. Defaults to 50.

Set this to 100 if you only want full chests to slow you down.

[b]Max Penalty[/b]

Maximum speed penalty when the carried chest is full. Defaults to 1.

[b]Show Icon[/b]

Whether to show the slowdown debuff icon in the UI. Defaults to false.

[size=5][b]Multiplayer[/b][/size]

PC multiplayer is supported. Farmhands can pick up and place chests; the host coordinates the world changes.

Carried chests stay carried across saves, disconnects, and reconnects. They are not automatically returned to the world.

[size=5][b]Supported Chests[/b][/size]

All player chest variants are supported, including normal chests, stone chests, big chests, Junimo Chests, Mini Shipping Bins, auto-loaders, and enrichers.

Non-player reward, treasure, and gift chests are not carryable.

[size=5][b]Limitations[/b][/size]

Multiplayer support is currently targeted at PC. Android multiplayer is not validated yet.

[size=5][b]Contributing[/b][/size]

The source code is at my [url=https://github.com/cylixlee/StardewValleyMods]GitHub repo[/url].
